thread:
Nora (Product): Quick sync to lock the console observability slice: route-level cost, sampled traces, and error analytics. Need a compact acceptance checklist + rollback gates.

Diego (Eng-runtime): Feasible. Plan: emit tiny span headers async; nonblocking. Default sampling 0.5% and SDK hook to force-capture.

Hannah (Eng-SRE): Ops guardrails: per-org daily cap, emergency capture window (1h), retention presets 7/30/90d. Require 5x synthetic load test pre-beta.

Priya (Design): UI idea: Cost table with sparkline + percent, Sampled Traces list (latency tag + flamegraph link), Error Groups with one sample each (redacted by default). I'll post compact mocks.

Ethan (Data): Schema draft: tags=[org_id, route_id, model, variant], fields=[tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, status]. Cost = tokens * model_unit_cost + infra_est. Backfill opt-in for 30d via batch job.

Nora (Product): Suggested launch gates: (1) per-route cost within 7% vs billing for beta orgs, (2) trace capture adds <12% to p99 inference latency, (3) error analytics surfaces top-5 groups with >=1 sample for 80% groups. Beta: 3 customers + internal teams. Feature-flagged rollout.

Diego (Eng-runtime): Implementation notes: nonblocking pre/post hooks, async uploader with backoff, server-side sampling rules (route/latency/org). Example config: {"default_rate":0.005, "overrides":[{"route":"chat-stream","rate":0.02},{"latency_ms_gt":800,"rate":1.0}] }.

Hannah (Eng-SRE): Rollback criteria: sustained p99 regression >15% for 30m, trace ingestion >2x autoscale forecast for >30m, or cost variance causing billing confusion. I'll add alerts & quotas.

deploy-bot: Ticket OBS-9001 created: "Console observability MVP: cost/traces/errors" -> https://redwood.example/OBS-9001

Nora (Product): Thanks all. Action items: Diego/Hannah -> ETA + perf test plan; Ethan -> publish schema + backfill runbook; Priya -> mocks. I'll draft the acceptance checklist and share.
